name: Angry Vegetation

stealth.details: DC 42 Perception check (master) to notice massive buds beneath the other foliage before they open

disable: DC 48 Nature check (master) or DC 48 Performance check (legendary) to calm a flower, closing it
reset: Wemmuths collapse into ordinary vines and the trap resets if the area is left alone for 1 minute.
routine:
2 If there are fewer wemmuths than open flowers, the flowers create more wemmuths (so there as many wemmuths as open flowers) as their first action.
For their second action, the flowers produce a mind-addling pollen. Each non-plant creature within 30 feet of a flower must succeed at a DC 41 Fortitude save save or become Slowed 1 for 1 round (or Confused for 1 round, on a critical failure). The pollen is an emotion, mental, and olfactory effect.

items.name: Bloom
items.text:
Trigger A non-plant creature enters the garden

---

Effect The blooms open, spawning a single Wemmuth that acts on the hazard's initiative, and the hazard rolls for initiative.

text: Five large flowers in the weed-choked field unfurl, each dusting pollen onto vines that animate into Wemmuths.
